title: [GameFreak部长专栏] 第185回
publication: 増田部長のめざめるパワー 第185回
summary: 增田抵达旧金山接受《黑白》采访，参观恶魔岛并体验巡回活动，终于坐上憧憬已久的宣传卡车。

source.title: 増田部長のめざめるパワー 第185回

body.markdown_zh:
我是身在旧金山的增田。 从伦敦过来花了11个小时……真远啊…… 在旧金山这两天，我要接受满满当当的《黑／白》采访！ 然后……在那之前…… 先好好享受一下旧金山。 ↑雾中的恶魔岛。 ↑增田和海狮都在这里！！ ↑看，真的在！真的在！！！ ↑像两年前来《白金》时一样，又经过金门大桥！好大！真帅！ 然后，我还去参加了《宝可梦黑／白》巡回活动！ [ﾂ?http://www.pokemon.com/us/news/bw_mall_tour-2011-01-10/](http://www.pokemon.com/us/news/bw_mall_tour-2011-01-10/) 地点是在圣何塞。 终于坐上了那辆我一直憧憬的卡车…… ↑坐上去啦！！！ 我喜欢卡车，甚至把它放进了《黑／白》里！ 又一个梦想实现的瞬间！看我这笑容（笑）！ ↑太棒了！！ ↑商场里还在销售小物件！试玩版、动画、电影，还有集章活动也都安排上了！现场人气超旺！ ↑捷克罗姆和莱希拉姆。大到感觉都能坐上去！ 听说接下来会把所有东西重新装进两辆卡车，前往下一个目的地！！ 加油啊，卡车司机师傅！！！ 下回再见呀！
查看官方英文版 This is Masuda reporting from San Francisco. It took 11 hours from London. It was quite far. I’ll have an interview for two days regarding Pokemon Black and White version here in San Francisco! And before that, I enjoy my stay in San Francisco. Alcatrazz island in the myst. Me and sea lions!! Take a look!!! Passing through the Golden Gate Bridge! Last time I visited was for Pokemon Platinum version two years ago. Huge! Cool! And… I visited Pokemon Black and White version tour! [ﾂ?http://www.pokemon.com/us/news/bw_mall_tour-2011-01-10/](http://www.pokemon.com/us/news/bw_mall_tour-2011-01-10/) Location is San Jose. Finally at last, my dream… comes to the real thing! I’m riding on it!!! I love trucks, so I showed them in Pokemon Black and White version. Another dream comes to reality! Look at my smile! Just superb!! Pokemon goods were selling at the shopping mall! Demo version can be played and animation, movies, stamp rally was held! It was just exciting! Zekrom and Reshiram. It’s big enough so people can ride on it! These two trucks are heading to the next destination with fully stuffed items and goods!! Keep it up! Drivers!! Ciao!
